originating_goal: Federal requirements are the minimum; exceed them for evidence-intake security.
release_condition: Release when the exact PR head has a passing Security Profile Verify run, artifacts or logs are inspected, and the canonical handoff records the result.
collision_boundaries: Do not change Toyota factual assertions or private evidence custody.
Do not merge or release without evidence-intake validation and separate authority.
Do not claim federal certification or compliance from repository validation.
next_task_after_release: Current-main validation and independent reproduction before release review.
